BiblicalUsage: The word names the wreath-shaped ornaments worked into the bronze bases Solomon had made for the temple. Lions, oxen and cherubim stood on the borders between the ledges, with the wreaths set beneath them and around them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the decoration of God's house was made with care, because nothing offered to Him is too small to be done well.
